answer_1.quote: we propose Debate-to-Detect (D2D), a novel MAD framework that simulates the fact-checking process through structured adversarial debates with LLM agents.
answer_1.outputs: The framework generates multi-turn dialogues between agents, produces debate summaries, and outputs authenticity scores with rationale.

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance using four standard metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.

answer_3.quote: Six judge agents are deployed, each evaluating arguments along specific dimensions... Each Judge assigns complementary integer scores summing to 7... adhering to a strict zero-sum structure.
